create_LSUMBase_dataset: create a PyTorch Dataset that loads images from a text file list with center cropping and normalization
use_LSUMBase_getitem: use LSUNBase __getitem__ to load, center crop, resize, and normalize an image to float32 in range [-1, 1]
create_LSUMChurchesTrain_dataset: create an LSUN churches training dataset with default 50% horizontal flip augmentation and configurable resize
create_LSUMBedroomsTrain_dataset: create an LSUN bedrooms training dataset with default 50% horizontal flip augmentation and configurable resize
create_LSUMCatsTrain_dataset: create an LSUN cats training dataset with default 50% horizontal flip augmentation and configurable resize
